app.name: Brevete Perú

about.title: About
about.p1: Brevete Perú is a free app for preparing for the MTC theory exam for a driver's license in Peru.
about.p2: It's made for people with A1 Spanish: every question is translated and comes with a line-by-line translation, an explanation and an “anchor” — the words that give away the right answer.
about.p3: All questions and answers are taken word for word from the official MTC balotario. Translations and explanations are generated automatically and may contain inaccuracies.
about.offline: Works offline after the first launch.
about.noTracking: No sign-up, ads or trackers. Your progress stays on your device only.
